jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a Desarrollo de Software
jobs_results.description:
Tras el periodo de formación, las funciones previstas son:

- Diseño y desarrollo de software de control, para el uso preciso y eficiente de brazos robóticos. Integración de algoritmos de control y procesamiento.

- Creación de interfaces de usuario gráficas (GUI) intuitivas.

- Implementar protocolos de comunicación para la integración eficiente del software con hardware robótico.

- Proporcionar mantenimiento continuo, actualizaciones del software, y soporte técnico.

Es un puesto versátil, con parte de trabajo de investigación sobre futuras tendencias y asesoramiento a los clientes.

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We’re looking for a product-oriented Software Engineer that enjoys taking ownership of complex problems with a big scope, working with the end customer as well as the rest of the engineering team to design and implement the best solution. We have a lean working environment with few meetings, focused on having a lot of delivery & interaction with the direct users of the product (mainly our internal account managers as well as the end customers). Engineers at Aldara have a lot of freedom to work on multiple challenges end-to-end, while at the same time forming part of a team with high standards for system architecture, code quality and product usability that fosters great work.

Here are the core traits that define how the tech team works at Aldara.

Lean engineering. Own the problem end-to-end

We don’t have Product Managers, Agile Coaches or Scrum Masters. We trust our engineers to be able to understand the problems at hand, devise the best solution, share it with others and own the... implementation from start to finish. The engineers who excel at Aldara are those that take pleasure in mastering all parts of the stack, from database modeling to UX design, to bring together a fully functional feature. The only big meetings we really have are the biweekly Demos, where engineers come together to share & showcase the latest changes to the rest of the company.

Horizontal structure with few but high quality contributors

You’ll be reporting directly to the CTO, while interacting heavily with Operations and Account Management to get the feedback cycle working. We don’t have teams in engineering, and we want to keep it that way as long as we can by hiring few but very high quality individual contributors. As an engineer, you’ll be deeply integrated with the rest of the team, working often with the internal stakeholders as well as the end customer. You will also be working closely with our providers, from local ones to big corps, as we develop our relationships with them as an additional player in our ecosystem. We believe a horizontal structure with a high motivation for debate brings forward the best product choices.

Focus on building great, scalable software, with rock-solid architecture to deploy it

Our stack is simple: Postgres, Django, React, Terraform, and AWS are the main pieces, with Datadog to keep track of it all. We care a lot about our developer UX and setup to make developers have the easiest time adding a new feature, testing it thoroughly and deploying it in the same beat. We’ve got 95% testing coverage checked on every PR, one-click deployments happening constantly and a carefully thought out code structure that focuses on modular software that can be easily reused. Our local setup replicates the production environment to a tee. Develop locally and instantly debug your traces using Datadog, comparing against production traces.

Freedom to explore and have fun, creativity is our best tool to engineer the future we want

We don’t shy away from investing time in trying out new approaches to problems we need to solve. There’s offsite weeks when we go hack on something for a few days in an amazing venue with full focus. Regular hackathons where the whole team reconfigures into small pods that build something fun for a day or two. We want to foster your curiosity, allow you to explore and find new and better ways to solve problems. We believe the future of our space includes way more automation, AI, and inference than it does now, and we’ll only get there by allowing you to be as creative as possible.

The product you’ll work on

Our current product has three parts: the internal software we use to manage properties, the consumer experience we offer to property owners, and the provider management platform.

Our internal software is the operating system of property management, used by our team of account managers to deliver an 11-star experience to our customers. This includes the streamlining of all aspects of building management: accounting, incident management, customer communications, taxes, utility management, insurance claims, etc.

This is coupled with an intuitive consumer experience, catering to a very diverse set of property owners. From the old grandparents to the star-eyed couple who just bought a flat. Our product has to be inclusive to all walks of life and offer the best service possible. It includes a digital application as well as traditional communication methods (in-person and over the phone).

Our provider platform allows our collaborators to interact with us in an easy and scalable way, and be motivated to work with us as much as possible. It will also give us an easy and structured way to have access to and discoverability of the best providers that can cover each of our customer’s needs.

Preferred Skills and experience
• Working experience across the stack. Ideally you’re someone familiar with our specific stack already (Postgres, Django, React) but this is not a hard requirement. We prioritize people who are good across the board rather than having deep experience with specific libraries.
• Strong ownership culture, you’re someone that enjoys owning big parts of the product and caring for them in all their facets.
• A hands-on attitude and willingness to spend the necessary time researching, analyzing, and identifying the problem to make decisions with as much data as possible to back them up.
• An open-minded approach to software development, with the ability to debate different trade-offs with strong yet highly rational arguments that prioritize what’s best for the project.
• A high level of proactivity and curiosity, we are looking for developers who are excited about problem-solving, thinking creatively comes to them naturally.
• Ability to work from our Barcelona office daily, with the option to work remotely occasionally if the need arises. We’re at the stage of the company where most of the interactions happen in-person, and we plan to keep it that way for the short and medium term.
• Proficiency in Spanish is highly desirable, though not a requirement.

Perks
• 📜 Have a go at changing an antiquated industry - opportunities to combine technology and operations to improve old, massive industries don’t happen every day. Be on the team tackling the challenges head-on, challenging the status quo and inventing ways to solve old problems.
• 📈 Stock Options - we would only imagine you joining us if you have skin in the game. For us, this means owning a piece of the company and sharing in the upside if we succeed.
• ⭐️ Work with a small team of bright people - we are strong believers in small but high impact teams. Expect to work with really talented colleagues with experience in top tech companies and multiple time founders. We keep a high quality bar and pride ourselves for our good work.
• 🤝 Company culture built on trust and transparency - we expect you to speak up and share your feedback openly, in turn we are completely open about our feedback and company direction.
• 🏢 In-person - we believe nothing beats being in the same room and spending time together. From deep working sessions to spending quality time off-work.
• 🤩 Beautiful office - our office is in one of the prime locations in Barcelona (Passeig de Gràcia), with direct view’s to Gaudi’s La Pedrera, and a large terrace where we organize events for our family, friends, and colleagues. Expect beautiful sunsets and easy access to the whole city.
• 👩🎨 Shape the culture - by joining so early in the team, we expect you to have a say in the future of the company, including ways of working, culture and direction. You’ll not only have a front row seat, but actively participate in developing the playbook that gets us to succeed

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer Java
jobs_results.description:
We are One Team. We make it happen. We are Unstoppable.

BABEL es una consultora tecnológica multinacional especializada en aplicar sus servicios y conocimiento tecnológico en los procesos de aceleración digital de sus clientes, grandes empresas y organismos públicos.

Estamos buscando profesionales como tú que nos ayuden a llegar Marte 2025.

¿Qué es Marte 2025?

¡Es nuestro objetivo! Llegar a 5000 babelievers en el mundo, es el reto que tenemos por delante, y por ello necesitamos profesionales que nos aporten innovación, liderazgo y experiencia internacional.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos nuevos/as compañeros/as que tenga entre 2 - 8 años de experiencia en proyectos de desarrollo de software con Java con los siguientes skills:
• Experiencia con Microservicios.
• Experiencia con base de datos relaciones y/o no relacionales.

#babel

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Babel es una compañía en un momento precioso de expansión, tenemos muchas oportunidades de desarrollo y un gran entorno de trabajo, basado... en la colaboración y la solidaridad.

Trabajar en Babel es unirse a un equipo de personas con una misión compartida y a un modelo de compañía centrado en valores.

Además,
• Apostamos por la flexibilidad laboral-personal. (Sistema de vacaciones por puntos, teletrabajo y flexibilidad).
• Invertimos en la formación de nuestros Babelievers.
• Invertimos en tu salud física y emocional. (Seguro Médico Privado/ Seguro de vida, entrenador personal y programa de wellbeing).
• Invertimos también en tu tiempo libre (Actividades en la naturaleza, campeonatos deportivos, suscripción a plataforma streaming (por Ej. Netflix)
• Participamos del crecimiento de la compañía y reconocemos la participación de cada persona (Bono de Beneficios).
• Ponemos foco en trabajar con últimas tecnologías y proyectos innovadores, pero sobre todo, acompañamos a la transformación digital y acercamos la tecnología a la sociedad.

¿Aceptas el desafío? ¡Te esperamos!

En cumplimiento de la normativa vigente en materia de protección de datos te informamos que el responsable de tus datos personales es GRUPO BABEL (consultar empresas en la política de privacidad), y los utilizará para gestionar tus procesos de selección, tanto actuales como futuros y el resto de finalidades descritas en la web. Este tratamiento está basado en el consentimiento del candidato. Los datos personales recabados no serán en ningún caso cedidos a terceros salvo por obligaciones legales expresas. Puedes ejercer los derechos que te asisten sobre protección de datos en la dirección data.protection@babelgroup.com. Toda la información sobre política de privacidad en nuestra web

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de software - Radares
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de la experiencia Exceltic, una empresa con estrategia centrada en las personas?

Si buscas formar parte de una gran variedad de proyectos punteros en una empresa tecnológica en fuerte expansión, ¡queremos conocerte!

Desde Exceltic buscamos incorporar un/a Ingeniero/a para el desarrollo del SW embebido de un radar.

Stack tecnológico: C/C++ y ADA; VxWorks; JIRA, LINUX, SCRUM

Requisitos:
• Al menos dos años trabajando con C/C++ o ADA en sistemas empotrados.

💫Vivir la experiencia Exceltic significa:
• Participar en proyectos punteros en donde puedas desarrollar tus habilidades.
• Percibir un salario competitivo en función de aportación.
• Disfrutar de un plan de retribución flexible.
• Equilibrar tu vida personal y profesional.
• Formar parte de un equipo en el que te sientas escuchado/a y en donde puedas aportar nuevas ideas.

💬Acerca de nosotros…

Somos una empresa de servicios de ingeniería y consultoría tecnológica. Desarrollamos nuestra actividad en... distintos sectores (Ferroviario, Aeronáutico, Espacio, Defensa, Energía, Automoción, Industria, Tecnologías de la Información y Telecomunicaciones). También proporcionamos servicios de auditoría técnica y formación especializada.

A día de hoy contamos con una sólida cartera de clientes multinacionales en los distintos sectores y una de las ofertas más completas del mercado.

En la familia Exceltic somos más de 500 miembros y contamos con oficinas en Madrid, Barcelona y Bilbao y con proyectos en los cinco continentes.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de software - Aviónica (Defensa)
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de la experiencia Exceltic, una empresa con estrategia centrada en las personas?

¿Tienes inquietud por conocer el sector técnico y tecnológico?

¡Ésta es tu oportunidad!👇

Estamos en búsqueda activa de un/a Ingeniero/a de software para participar en el desarrollo de modelos de SW para la simulación en el proyecto más importante que se esta desarrollando a nivel europeo en defensa.

✅Tus funciones se centrarán en:
• Desarrollo de software orientado a objetos
• Desarrollo de modelos de SW para la simulación Simlab

🔎¿Qué buscamos?

jobs_results.title: Software engineer (Java) Rail Signalling
jobs_results.description:
Siemens Mobility is a separately managed company of Siemens. As a leader in transport solutions for more than 160 years, Siemens Mobility is constantly innovating its portfolio in its core areas of rolling stock, rail automation and electrification, turnkey systems, intelligent traffic systems as well as related services. With digitalization, Siemens Mobility is enabling mobility operators worldwide to make infrastructure intelligent, increase value sustainably over the entire lifecycle, enhance passenger experience and guarantee availability.

We are a collaborative, proactive group, learning every day, achieving quality products on time, overcoming challenges and aware of what we contribute to society. If you want to work on Generic products valid for any part of the world and work with international teams, this is the place for you.

We are leaders in cutting-edge technology for the Railway Signaling sector, developing innovative products and solutions for the satisfaction of its... customers and that is why for the R&D Department, we want to join a Software Engineers who will be responsible for the design and development of control system software, according to the design/product specifications.

Main functions and responsibilities:
• Software development for specific Siemens solutions.
• Design, implement and modify software using the Java programming language, using JMS messaging and PostgreSQL database manager.
• Assume assigned responsibilities during the entire software development cycle, including the bid, specification, design, development, test, and delivery phase.
• Software verification activities.
• Test specification.
• Requirements management and traceability throughout the product life cycle.
• Working in an international and multidisciplinary development team.
• Innovation and research on new technologies applied to products.

Requirements:
• Software engineer (computer science, industrial, telecommunications, computer science)
• Minimum 3 years experience in research projects
• Desirable experience in the development of applications for Railway Signalling Control Centres

Knowledge:
• Knowledge in JAVA programming language (in its absence C++).
• Extensive knowledge of SW architecture, JAVA messaging and relational databases.
• Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Subversion, Synergy.
• Knowledge of automatic testing and continuous integration tools (Jenkins, SonarQube)
• Knowledge of requirements and traceability management tools (Doors, Confluence)
• Knowledge of assembly and maintenance of environments
• Knowledge in cloud and container architectures, dockers / kubernetes and related tools.
• Knowledge of SIL2 development techniques ( CENELEC 50128:2011 )

It will be assessed:
• Knowledge of AGILE software development methodology (SCRUM) and related tools (Jira, Gitlab, RTC).
• Knowledge of graphic systems software development.
• IT Security (vulnerability testing, threat mitigation, authentication, access control, cryptography).
• Programming using code standards and following good development practices

Skills:
• Ability to work effectively across multiple geographic locations.
• Ability to work in a team, good communication skills and a results-oriented approach
• Good level of technical English and Spanish, spoken and written.
• Leadership
• Exhaustive/meticulous/organized person
• A person with a spirit of innovation and with the motivation to develop research and development work in new technologies.

If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit great minds from all walks of life. We recognise that building a diverse workforce is essential to the success of our business, therefore we encourage applications from a diverse talent pool. We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility requirements with our applicants to encourage agile working and innovation. Flexibility is our main benefit. We combine remote and presence work because work-life balance and wellbeing are essential for our teams. We are convinced that stay at home allow us to focus on activities that need more time for concentration and being at the office enhance our creativity collaborating and learning from others.

Siemens aboga por la igualdad de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres, así como en la Diversidad como fuente de creatividad e innovación. Contar con diferentes tipos de talento y de experiencias nos hace ser más competitivos y estar mejor preparados para responder con éxito a las demandas de la Sociedad. Por ello, valoramos a las candidatas y a los candidatos que reflejen la Diversidad que disfrutamos en nuestra Compañía y animamos la cobertura de puestos por mujeres y hombres en ocupaciones que se encuentren subrepresentadas

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero Software
jobs_results.description:
El objetivo de este puesto de ingeniero de software es diseñar, desarrollar y mantener software de vanguardia para un proyecto lider, en un entorno dinámico y de ritmo rápido. El ingeniero de software trabajará en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de hardware, y otros departamentos para crear e implementar soluciones innovadoras. El ingeniero deberá estar al día de las últimas tendencias y avances del sector y aportar nuevas ideas y enfoques.

Funciones y responsabilidades

Diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de software para un proyecto de nueva generación
Colaborar con el equipo de hardware, expertos en visión artificial y otras partes interesadas para crear e implementar soluciones innovadoras.
Escribir código limpio, fácil de mantener y eficiente
Participar en revisiones de código y garantizar que el software cumple los estándares de calidad.
Crear y mantener la documentación del software
Solucionar y depurar problemas a medida que surjan
Mantenerse al día de las últimas... tendencias y avances del sector y aportar nuevas ideas y enfoques
Contribuir a la mejora continua de nuestros procesos de desarrollo de software

Requisitos.
Licenciatura o Máster en Informática, Ingeniería Eléctrica o un campo relacionado
Más de 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software, con especial atención a C++ y Python
Gran capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas
Familiaridad con herramientas de desarrollo de software como Git, JIRA y metodologías ágiles.
Se valorará conocimiento en integración.
Excelentes capacidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo
Pasión por la tecnología y por estar al día de las últimas tendencias del sector
Gran conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de desarrollo de software
Capaz de trabajar en un entorno de inicio de ritmo rápido
Conocimiento de las normas de calidad ISO y familiaridad con la gestión de la calidad.

Si te interesa, no dudes en remitirnos tu Cv actualizado

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer (C+, Systems)
jobs_results.description: At Trunk, our mission is to help teams create high-quality software quickly. Merge conflicts, poor code quality or consistency, flaky tests, and dozens of other distractions quickly drain the productivity and morale of those teams. Engineering teams that can stay focused on designing, implementing, and delivering software will build magical, high-quality projects - and they will be happier doing it. We're building the tools that empower teams to land code faster and develop happier.We are building the foundation for a modern software engineering team. Our founders started this journey in 2021 and have designed, delivered, and scaled software at some of the world's largest and fastest-growing tech companies - Uber, Google, YouTube, and Microsoft. We're building a game-changing company, and we hope you are excited to be a part of that audacious goal.Software has eaten the world; almost every company produces software in some form or fashion, so our addressable market is virtually every... company on earth. We're going after every engineering team on the planet - we're starting with smaller teams, but there are literally hundreds of thousands of companies out there for us to empower and maybe only a handful (Google, Facebook, Amazon), that are outside our scope. We are building the DevEx platform to empower the world.In 2022, we raised a $25M Series A led by Initialized Capital (Garry Tan) and a16z (Peter Levine), with investments from Haystack Ventures, Garage VC, Tom Preston Warner (Founder/CEO of GitHub), Geoff Schmidt (Founder/CEO Apollo GraphQL), Nicolas Dessaigne (Founder/CEO Algolia), and Oleg Rognysky (Founder/CEO Peopl.ai).What you'll do Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines.Propose, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance the Trunk's local development tools (CLI, daemon, language server, IDE extensions)Build new user-facing features using modern C++ (Rust experience is a plus)Improve analytics, monitoring, and alerts to our software to better respond to operational incidentsRedefine best-in-class software development processes so that we can build an opinionated productWe're looking for 5+ years of professional experienceExperience building new user-facing features using modern C++ (Rust experience is a plus)Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills and the tenacity to drive a solution to a conclusionExperience and intuition to zero in on root causes for bugs that can leave others stumpedThe ability to operate independently but know when you are in too deep and need to ask for helpOur tech stack Frontend: Typescript, React, Next.jsBackend: Typescript, Node, AWS, CDK, k8s, gRPCObservability: Prometheus, Grafana, Kiali, JaegerCLI/Daemon/LSP: C++20, Bazel, a bit of RustVSCode Extension: TypescriptCI/CD: GitHub ActionsGeneral: GitHub, Slack, Linear, SliteWhat we offer Unlimited PTOCompetitive salary and equityWork-life balanceFlexibility to be fully or partly remoteFew meetings, so you can ship fast and focus on buildingOne Medical membership on us!Top-notch medical, dental, vision, short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insuranceAll insurance is 100% company-paid ($0 premiums) for employees and highly subsidized for dependantsFSA, HSA with company contributions, and pre-tax commuter benefits401(k) planPaid parental leave ( up to 12 weeks)The salary and equity range for this role are: $150K - $210K and .15% - .35%.Don't meet every single requirement? At Trunk, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, we're happy to help accommodate. Please contact us at ******.#J-18808-Ljbffr
